title: Box good, mounting stinks
text: Box good, mounting stinks. The box itself is good. Do not waste your time using the mounting hardware that comes with it. It is garbage. It will NOT secure the box to the wall. You will end up going to the hardware store to purchase screws and wall Molly's that actually work. Use part of the packing box for a template to mark your holes.

Assorted hooks and abundant storage for all jewelry also including a keyed locking mechanism

description: With plenty of space and organizers, this transitional wall mount jewelry mirror securely stores all your delicate treasures in one place. The front beveled mirror adds elegance to the plantation oak finish. Black felt lined interior offers double, single, and flat hanging hooks for necklaces or bracelets, earring notches, cushioned ring rows, and storage bins in a removable tray. This gorgeous piece also features a key locking mechanism and includes 3 screw holes for wall mounting. Dimensions include: Overall: 14.5" W x 4.25" D x 48.25" H; Storage: 6 double hooks, 22 flat hooks, 10 single hooks, 30 earring notches, 8 cushioned ring holders, and 4 bins; Mirror: 9.75" W x 43" H; Ring rows: 7.5" W; Bins: 2.25" W x 1.5" D x 1" H. This one-of-a-kind item weighs approximately 31.5 pounds. Only quality materials and manufacturing will do. Product materials include: Chinese oak, plywood, felt, 3mm mirror w/ .25" bevel, metal. Assembly: No assembly required; ready to hang. Made in China
